user.title: Connect to Cummins Connect Cloud
user.description: Paste the refresh token produced by running `tools/bootstrap_login.py` on your laptop (see the repository README). Home Assistant only ever sees this token, never your Cummins/Salesforce password.

asset.title: Choose a generator
asset.description: More than one generator was found on this account. Pick the one to add now — run setup again to add another.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Cummins Connect Cloud
reauth_confirm.description: The stored refresh token is no longer valid (it may have expired or been revoked). Run `tools/bootstrap_login.py` again and paste the new refresh token below.

error.invalid_auth: The refresh token was rejected. It may be expired or revoked — re-run the bootstrap tool.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Cummins Connect Cloud. Check your network connection and try again.
error.no_assets: No generators were found on this Cummins account.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.
